naturalStatement: The intersection of two finite sets is contained in the first.
expectedFormalTarget: theorem rb_set_004 {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s t : Finset α) : s ∩ t ⊆ s

knownProof.leanBody:
by
  intro x hx
  exact (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).left
